text:
lina: Heads-up — I hit a 404 in the runtime guide's CLI examples on staging. The curl gist is returning 404: https://staging.redwood.ai/runtime/cli#auth. Anyone available to own a tiny patch?

sam: I can take a look in ~30m. Is it the curl snippet itself or the embedded gist iframe?

lina: It's the embedded gist (the curl example). When you click the gist it 404s. Looks like the original gist was removed.

docs-bot: automated scan detected: docs/runtime/cli.md -> external gist 403/404 (last checked 2026-03-21). Suggested action: rehost gist under /kb/gists or replace with inline snippet.

maria: Assigning to @sam for triage — if it's quick can you rehost the snippet under our internal gist bucket and open a tiny PR? If you need me to shepherd the review I can.

sam: ok grabbing it now. plan: copy the curl snippet into a new internal gist, update md to use our embed, and add a 1-line note in the PR about provenance. Quick question — do we prefer embeds or inline code for CLI samples?

maria: prefer inline code for tiny snippets (less flaky). If it's >8 lines maybe gist embed is fine.

sam: got it. replacing with inline code then. snippet I'll use: 

```bash
# authenticate
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/auth \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"api_key":"$REDWOOD_KEY"}'
```

jonathan: tiny nit — can you also update the anchor to `#cli-auth`? we had a TOC rename last week so anchors drifted.

sam: noted. PR coming shortly. I'll ping here when it's up for review.

sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4127 — replaces gist with inline snippet, fixes anchor, adds test case for curl rendering in CI. reviewers: @maria @jonathan

maria: looking now, will do a quick pass and approve if CI green.

preview-bot: staging preview updated: https://staging.redwood.ai/runtime/cli#cli-auth (preview build 2026-03-21-2330).

jonathan: lgtm after the small frontmatter tweak I left in the PR comment.

sam: thanks — merged and backfilled the anchor redirect. Closing out.

lina: awesome, thanks everyone :tada:
